newsitem.title: USA: Nissan recalls 750 cars to fix doors.
newsitem.headline: Nissan recalls 750 cars to fix doors.

text.p: Nissan Motor Corp USA said it will recall about 750 Sentra sedans in the U.S. that were inadvertently built and shipped without rear-door side-impact pads.
Nissan said the Sentras involved in the recall were 1997 models manufactured between May 21 and June 5.

The company said its dealers will install the missing pads -- which help assure that the vehicles meet federal safety standards for side impact protection -- in each rear door at no charge to customers. Nissan builds the Sentra at its Smyrna, Tenn., plant.
